output.title: Exquisite 4-Bedroom Penthouse with Panoramic City Views in Prestigious Belair
output.description:
Offering a harmonious blend of sophisticated design and unparalleled comfort, this exquisite 220 m² penthouse epitomizes upscale living within Luxembourg’s most coveted residential enclave, Belair. Nestled amidst serene tree-lined streets and manicured gardens, the property provides an exclusive retreat that gracefully balances urban sophistication with tranquil greenery.

Step into the luminous open-plan living area, accentuated by floor-to-ceiling windows that flood the space with natural light and frame expansive panoramic views of Luxembourg City. The refined oak parquet flooring and elegant wood-burning fireplace contribute to a warm yet contemporary ambiance, perfectly suited for both intimate gatherings and grand entertaining. Integrated smart-home lighting enhances the setting’s modern allure.

The sleek, minimalist kitchen is a chef’s dream, outfitted with top-tier Gaggenau appliances, a striking Carrara marble island, and a discreet integrated wine fridge. Matte black fixtures underscore the kitchen’s professional-grade quality, while the generous central island invites conviviality and culinary creativity.

Retreat to the master suite, a sanctuary of serene refinement featuring a spacious walk-in closet, an ensuite bathroom, and private access to a tranquil terrace. Three additional bedrooms offer ample space, comfort, and privacy for family or guests. The expansive south-facing terrace beckons with composite decking, a contemporary outdoor lounge, and unobstructed 180-degree views of the city skyline, perfect for alfresco relaxation or entertaining beneath the sky.

Additional conveniences include secure parking, a storage room, and elevator access. Meticulously renovated with an emphasis on quality and detail, this penthouse presents a rare opportunity to reside within an exclusive, upscale neighborhood offering both privacy and proximity to the vibrant city center.

highlights.text: Expansive 220 m² penthouse with 4 bedrooms and 3 bathrooms
Panoramic 180-degree city views from floor-to-ceiling windows
State-of-the-art Gaggenau kitchen with Carrara marble island
South-facing rooftop terrace with composite decking and lounge area
Private master suite with walk-in closet and terrace access
Integrated smart-home lighting and newly renovated interiors
Secure parking, storage space, and elevator service
Located in prestigious, green, and family-friendly Belair neighborhood
